bowties.Top_Event: Loss of Primary Containment on Crude Distillation Column V-101
bowties.Hazard: High-temperature hydrocarbon liquid and volatile flammable vapor at 350 C and 2.5 barg

Threats.Description: Overhead condenser cooling water loss causing rapid column pressure surge
Preventive_Barriers: Cooling water low flow alarm PIC-101

Threats.Description: Crude feed water slugging creating sudden steam flashing expansion

Mitigating_Barriers: Pressure relief valves PSV-101A/B routed to closed flare system
Column bottom emergency quench oil injection
Perimeter hydrocarbon gas detection and deluge water curtain
Consequences: Atmospheric flammable cloud and vapor cloud explosion (VCE)
Emergency refinery shutdown and asset structural thermal damage

bowties.Top_Event: High-Pressure Hydrogen Release in Hydrocracker Reactor Circuit R-201
bowties.Hazard: Hydrogen-rich hydrocarbon gas at 160 barg and 410 C with H2S toxicity

Threats.Description: Catalyst bed temperature runaway exceeding design metallurgical limits
High-temperature hydrogen attack (HTHA) or creep cracking on vessel nozzle

Mitigating_Barriers: Automated high-speed blowdown to high-pressure flare
Remote isolation ESD valves at reactor inlet and outlet
Fixed fire fighting monitor towers with foam capability
Consequences: High-pressure jet fire and catastrophic vessel burst
Toxic H2S exposure to plant personnel
